name: Casper
intro: Found in the winter rain, cold, hungry and barely one kilo.
before_body:
I found Casper on the street in the middle of winter. It was raining, and he was freezing and very, very hungry. He weighed barely a kilo, so thin you could feel every bone.

He was covered in fleas, had a fungal skin infection and a bad cold, and ear mites had gone deep inside his ears.
care_body: We ran blood tests and kept taking him back to the clinic for check-ups. Thankfully, his bloodwork showed we had reached him just in time. Little by little he gained weight, his fur grew back, and he turned into the beautiful boy you see today.
after_title: Home in Milan, with Moka and Luca
after_body:
I started sharing his story, and found him a wonderful home in Milan, Italy. The same family had already adopted Moka and Luca from us, and Casper was the last of the three to fly to them.

Today the three of them share one happy home.
